question: In a certain code language, 'JACKET' is written as 'EAKCTJ'. How will 'BLAZER' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

'JACKET' is written as 'EAKCTJ'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87d3de9663e307a3ae2f2fcfc51a03899567e9a61b630e9f08b86a23de55c65f.png] 

Similarly,

'BLAZER' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/858a420342008aaa490b31a4a1e7496ae33e6c61f4b709cc41fbdd9adc1e533b.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"ELZARB".**
